description: Elliott Wave map for one coin and timeframe (Asrai's rule-based count, confirmed swings only): the main count, 1–2 alternative counts, the next target and the price that proves the count WRONG, plus Fibonacci levels. Use for 'Elliott wave count of X'. Present it as a map, not a forecast or a buy/sell signal: on 7 years of 650+ coins the counts were right about as often as chance — the one exception is '5 waves up done', after which a pullback to the 38.2% level came ~70% of the time (vs ~64% at random), and even that did not make money as a short trade with real stops. Always quote the 'wrong if' price; weigh it below trend and price structure.
